audio.voText: The bridge is broken, and the little beaver on the other side is waiting to come home.

meta.title: 1. Setup — the broken bridge
meta.goal: Introduce the beaver family and the broken bridge. No interaction yet.

audio.voText: Beaver tries to push a log into place... but it won't budge.

meta.title: 2. Logs — try alone
meta.goal: Child presses and holds the log pile alone — it does not budge. Elephant idle, not yet involved.

meta.title: 5. Ropes — try alone
meta.goal: Rope hangs loose at a fixed point. Child drags it alone — it always slips and resets. Monkey nearby playing with a twig, not helping yet.

audio.voText: Beaver tries to pull the rope tight... but it keeps slipping loose.

meta.title: 4. Logs — help arrives, push together
meta.goal: Elephant notices (help bubble) and walks over. Child holds again with Elephant helping — log(s) slide into their support slot(s), repeating until all slots are filled. Bridge reads "supported."

Elephant hears it and comes right over.

meta.title: 3. Logs — call for help
meta.goal: Beaver failed alone. A help bubble appears — child drags it onto Elephant to summon him.

meta.title: 11. Symbol reveal
meta.goal: Warm pause, then the Kurumedeva symbol appears with its affirmation line.

meta.title: 10. Reunion
meta.goal: Beaver reaches Baby Beaver — reunion/hug animation. Hold — no interaction.

meta.title: 9. Crossing
meta.goal: Beaver auto-walks the finished bridge to the far side. Hold — no interaction.

audio.voText: The bridge is ready! Beaver crosses to the other side at last.

meta.title: 8. Planks — lay (Beaver alone)
meta.goal: No helper needed. Child drags the plank pair from the pile onto the bridge — bridge reads fully complete.

meta.title: 7. Ropes — help arrives, tie together
meta.goal: Monkey notices (help bubble) and walks over. Child drags the rope with Monkey’s help into the knot target — ties successfully, repeating for the second rope. Bridge structurally complete underneath.
